Beasts

Beasts

Natural predators, swarms, and wildlife of the Scatter’s islands and waters.

Large Predators

  • Giant Crocodile — Apex ambush predator of the tidal rivers and mangrove channels of the Midchain
  • Giant Constrictor Snake — Found in rainforest interiors of the Midchain and Verdant Teeth; large enough to pin and suffocate a horse
  • Giant Ape — Territorial apex predator of dense rainforest interiors; sightings at Sorn suggest at least one family controls the highland canopy
  • Giant Boar — Charges without warning from undergrowth of the Crown Islands; big enough to stave in a ship’s boat
  • Giant Shark — Follows cold upwellings and blood trails; a serious threat near Galewall‘s wreckage and along the Tail‘s longline grounds
  • Giant Squid — Deep-water ambush predator that rises from the drop-off at night; a hazard for divers at the Shelfworks
  • Panther — Silent apex predator of the dense canopy of the Verdant Teeth; a party may be stalked for hours before it commits
  • Tiger — Forest and grassland predator; fast, powerful, and rarely seen before the first strike
  • Owlbear — Ambush predator of the dense interior forests of the Crown Islands; the screech is usually the last thing heard before contact
  • Primeval Owlbear — A massive prehistoric variant, CR 7; significantly stronger and more durable than its common cousin
  • Giant Axe Beak — Aggressive flightless predator on the clifftop scrublands of the Crown Islands and exposed ridgelines; fast enough to run down a horse

Birds

  • Giant Eagle — Nests in the clifftop aeries of the High Eyrie; large enough to carry a grown sailor
  • Giant Vulture — Carrion bird found wherever the sea deposits its dead; circles the clifftops of the High Eyrie and the Ashwall Islands
  • Giant Owl — Nocturnal forest hunter of the old-growth interiors of the Crown Islands; near-silent on the wing
  • Pegasus — Rumoured to range the updrafts above the High Eyrie; the Sentinels claim sightings but treat the subject as a private matter
  • Unicorn — Unconfirmed; a single account from a Midchain interior expedition describes a white-maned creature that vanished before anyone else could see it

Reptiles and Amphibians

  • Giant Lizard — Rocky-shore and ruin predator of the Sunken Crown and Keth-Naar; territorial and fast
  • Giant Toad — Ambush predator of boggy lowlands and freshwater margins of Karath
  • Giant Frog — Marshland and tidal-flat ambush predator of Sorn, the Verdant Teeth, and Orak
  • Constrictor Snake — Common tree-and-water snake of the Midchain lowlands; large enough to take a dog
  • Giant Venomous Snake — Large ambush serpent of the mid-canopy and river margins in the Verdant Scatter and Karath
  • Venomous Snake — Common bite hazard of the Verdant Teeth undergrowth; small enough to go unnoticed until stepped on
  • Giant Seahorse — Large enough to serve as a mount; found in sheltered reef waters of the Central Strait

Arthropods and Arachnids

  • Giant Scorpion — Found in dry rocky terrain of the Ashwall Islands; hides under flat stone and inside hollow logs
  • Giant Spider — Web-builder of the deep jungle interior; found across the Verdant Scatter, Karath, and Orak
  • Giant Wolf Spider — Hunting spider of the undergrowth of the Crown Islands and Ral-Arn; doesn’t web, runs fast
  • Giant Wasp — Nests in cliff overhangs and hollow shoreline trees around the Doldrums and Kalowe; disturbing one nest sends the whole colony
  • Giant Centipede — Found under loose stone and damp timber throughout Sorn; bites rather than charges
  • Giant Crab — Intertidal heavyweight of the Crown Islands beaches; large enough to shear rope
  • Giant Octopus — Reef-dwelling ambush predator in the rocky shallows of the Central Strait

Small Creatures and Pests

  • Giant Bat — Cave-roosting hunter of the Ashwall Islands and the Tail; emerges at dusk in columns thick enough to blot the stars
  • Giant Rat — Dock-bred pest of Kalowe‘s warehouses; larger than a cat and aggressive when cornered
  • Giant Weasel — Burrow hunter of the Crown Islands forest floor; occasionally found in cargo holds after a Crown Islands layover
  • Boar — Common feral hog of the scrubland and coastal heath of the Crown Islands

Swarms

  • Swarm of Bats — Vast cave colony of the sea-cliff overhangs of the Ashwall Islands; the evening departure sounds like distant thunder
  • Swarm of Rats — Hull-rot hazard of Kalowe‘s waterfront; infests badly-kept stowage and spreads between vessels in harbour
  • Swarm of Ravens — Carrion flock from the cliffs of Vel-Orn; circles over a vessel in distress is a universally understood bad sign
  • Swarm of Insects — Working hazard of the Verdant Teeth jungle floor; biting clouds that can force a camp to move in under an hour
  • Swarm of Piranhas — Found in still interior lakes and spring-fed pools of Midchain islands
  • Swarm of Venomous Snakes — Disturbed nest or flooded burrow; the interior undergrowth harbours more than it shows
  • Swarm of Larvae — Linked to planar scarring near Antheri Ruins; larval forms of the damned that swarm toward the living
